response.overview: The series follows Roman, a 12-year-old street kid documenting the underworld through a retro 35mm lens, alongside a nomad netrunner out for blood and a veteran merc battling the edge of cyberpsychosis. Melding high-octane Studio Trigger animation with 90s VHS aesthetics, it explores raw themes of generational trauma, corporate greed, and the cost of holding onto humanity.
response.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2
